shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "test -d node_modules/next/dist/docs && find node_modules/next/dist/docs -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | head -120 || (printf 'No local Next.js docs found.\\n'; test -d node_modules/next || printf 'No installed next package.\\n')"

/bin/bash -c "cat AGENTS.md && printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- app files ---\\n' && for file in app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/UserProfile.tsx app/ProductList.tsx; do printf '\\n--- %s ---\\n' \""'$file"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$file"; done'

/bin/bash -c "git status --short && printf '\\n--- project files ---\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules/**'"' | sort | head -160 && printf '\\n--- TypeScript config ---\\n' && cat tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null || true"
/bin/bash -c "git diff --check -- app/UserProfile.tsx && git diff -- app/UserProfile.tsx && nl -ba app/UserProfile.tsx | sed -n '1,100p'"
